defect: The deserializing constructor is picked by ascending parameter count (ThenBy) instead of descending (ThenByDescending), so with several equally accessible constructors the one with the fewest parameters wins.
why: The collector is meant to prefer the most complete constructor; binding the smallest one leaves members out of the constructor call and attaches constructor diagnostics to the wrong constructor.
